title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When thinking about reducing model variance, consider how transformations can affect the spread of your data. A transformation that compresses the range of your data might help in reducing variance.

title: Exploring Transformations
text: Think about how the transformation $$f(x)=\frac{1}{x}$$ affects the values of $$x$$. What happens to the values as $$x$$ increases or decreases? How might this impact the variance of the model?

title: Analyzing the Transformation
text: Consider the behavior of the function $$f(x)=\frac{1}{x}$$. What happens to f(x) as $$x$$ approaches zero?

title: Impact on Variance
text: How does the transformation $$f(x)=\frac{1}{x}$$ affect the spread of data values?
choices: It has no effect on the spread
